patch_description: Headroom analysis: correlation/efficiency are effectively saturated on the low-lag variants; the binding constraints are smoothness (0.30-0.38) and false reversals (26). Program 4 showed the final zero-phase SG pass helps; here we (a) strengthen that polish by using h_final = sg_half//2 and applying it twice (zero-phase => no lag cost, order-2 kernel preserves genuine curvature), and (b) tighten the soft reversal gate threshold from 0.25 to 0.40 * q_scale so noise-level slopes no longer produce lead-driven spurious reversals, cutting false_reversals without harming genuine trend compensation.
